purpose: Bounded visual test of deterministic 2D reference-guided native-grid abstraction from the approved Exilada body turnaround.
success_condition: Candidate reads at native 1x and gameplay context as intentional modern pixel art while preserving the approved adult Exilada body proportions/presence, without mannequin or reduced-illustration/filter appearance.
failure_condition: Any filtered/reduced illustration reading, mannequin/procedural reading, weak anatomy, lost Exilada presence, or unacceptable pelvic/hand/foot readability closes V3 without promotion.
next_if_pass: Freeze/re-author accepted native cluster language into a persistent B3B production source and add deterministic validator/export tooling.
next_if_fail: Record V3 visual failure; do not promote; B3B remains current. No model cleanup applies because V3 downloads no model weights.
